changelog:
- Initial release of github-rising-stars skill.
- Enables discovery of fast-growing GitHub repositories before they reach the Trending page.
- Allows filtering by days since creation, minimum star count, number of results, and language.
- Ranks new repositories by stars per day and filters out known spam or low-quality projects.
- Provides clear usage instructions, script options, and guidance on interpreting results.
summary: Discover fast-growing GitHub repositories before they appear on the official Trending page. Use when users ask to find emerging/rising GitHub projects, spot...
